query_plan.query: Since how many years do bundesliga clubs exist on average? Today is the 20.02.2032.

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by club, then compute the average number of years since founding. Today is the 20.02.2032.
steps.query: Return all bundesliga clubs together with how many years they have existed. Today is the 20.02.2032.

extra.sql_query: SELECT AVG(strftime('%Y', '2032-02-20') - strftime('%Y', football_clubs.founded)) AS average_years_existing FROM football_clubs WHERE football_clubs.league = 'Bundesliga'

s1.sql_query: SELECT football_clubs.team AS team, CAST(strftime('%Y','2032-02-20') - strftime('%Y', football_clubs.founded) AS REAL) AS years_existing FROM football_clubs WHERE football_clubs.league = 'Bundesliga'
